intro: Djibouti has about 1.1 million people, most living in the capital.

chapters.title: People
text: The Somali Issa and the Afar are the largest groups. French and Arabic are official. Almost everyone is Muslim.

chapters.title: Djibouti City
text: About three-quarters of people live in Djibouti City.

keyTerms.meaning: A people of the Horn of Africa.
